mudflat_shellfish.action: tilted front-side three-quarter mudflat shellfish-gathering cycle; stay in a deep low squat with both feet planted and knees bent throughout; frame 1 presses a short wooden hand rake into unseen mud, frame 2 scrapes it toward the body, frame 3 reaches down with the free hand to pick up a shell, frame 4 deposits it into a small shallow woven basket held tight beside the knee and returns toward the first pose; the rake and basket remain physically connected to the hands or body; preserve the same facing and body orientation in all frames; no standing upright, no walking, no kneeling on both knees, no fishing pole, no large shoulder net
